notes.subject: באזני יהוה צבאות
notes.rationale: 'Long ol ar bilong mi' — namba 9 i tanim olsem 'In mine ears said the LORD', tasol Haitus per-token data i tok 'באזני' i ken min 'long ol sena bilong', olsem na 'צבאות' i ken min 'ol wepin'; dispela pasin bilong tanim 'weapon' (ylt) i stap tu.

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩ tok
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat tok bilong 'tok'; Tok Pisin i nidimpredicate marker na tok bilong mekim klia.

notes.subject: אם לא
notes.rationale: Oath formula — 'sapos no' i min 'i tru tru' (of a truth); tanim tok literal i no givim mining bilong solwara.

translation: Long ol ar bilong mi, Yahwe Tsebaot ⟨i⟩ tok: sapos no, planti haus bai ⟨i⟩ kamap bagarap tru, ol haus bikpela tru na gutpela tru, i no gat man i stap insait.
